absences: NRC Part 57 final rule: no final rule found as of 2026-11-05. The 2026-11-23 final-rule target is from secondary search summaries citing EO 14300, not from an NRC page. The NRC rulemaking page fetch gave no schedule (docket NRC-2025-0379 not read).

Texas Backup Power Package (16 TAC 25.513): the adopted text was not reached. Confirmed only that the PUCT adopted the rule on 2026-05-07 and that the systems must combine natural gas or propane generation, battery storage and solar. The $1.8B figure and the 2.5 MW limit (from a pre-adoption advisory report) are unverified, and the 'nuclear not eligible' claim was not confirmed against adopted text. No check written.

Louisiana 'nuclear tariff' (Commissioner Skrmetta; 20 cents per customer per month for Entergy Louisiana, Cleco and SWEPCO; feasibility work on SMRs and microreactors): no docket number or filing link found. Vote postponed to the 2026-09-16 meeting; outcome not found. Not written as a Type F docket because it has no docketed filing URL.

Dockets filed or decided 2026-08-07 to 2026-11-05 naming microreactors or SMRs: none verified. Checked and rejected as out of window or unverifiable: Virginia SCC Rider SMR (PUR-2025-00196, filed 2025-11-03, hearing 2026-05-05, final order not found), West Virginia HB 4491 (introduced 2026-01-19, status unknown), Alaska HB 142 (single trade source, unconfirmed).

Congress: no November 2026 microreactor bill found; FY2027 NDAA House-passed (216-212), Senate status and any microreactor section not found; FY2027 Energy & Water passed House committee, House floor status not confirmed. NRC: no November 2026 Commission vote or approval found. DOE/Army: Launch Pad round 2 (2026-08-25) and Janus awards (2026-08-26/27) predate the window. CNSC: no 2026 microreactor decision found. ONR (UK): not searched. Texas SMR Long Mott (NRC construction permit final stage, 2026-11-02) is a 320 MWe X-energy plant, out of 1-20 MW scope, so not written.

Texas HB 14 $350M fund: the shipped text does not mention the statutory limit that the ~$280M construction reimbursement program can only sign with projects that have a docketed NRC application. Not an error, so no check written.
Part 53 effective date: sources disagree (2026-04-29 versus 2026-05-26). Shipped text states only 'finalised ... March 2026' and was not checked.

checks.target: The ADVANCE Act halved the hourly review rate
checks.claim: The 2024 law directed NRC to produce microreactor-specific licensing strategies across eight areas (done, January 2026) and cut the hourly rate advanced-reactor applicants pay for review from $318 to $148 (it is $154 under the FY2026 fee rule), a concrete cost advantage available now.
checks.evidence: Federal Register, FY 2026 fee schedules final rule, published 2026-06-16: the FY 2026 Reduced Hourly Rate is $154 per hour, up from $148. The shipped '$154 under the FY2026 fee rule' is correct.

SB 978 (amended March 2026) would go further for large data centers: backup power restricted to onsite solar, wind or battery storage only. Microreactors are not on the eligible list.
